# Kia Sorento Rental Agreement

## 1. Parties

This agreement is between Kigali Keys (the owner) and the guest named on the associated booking (the renter). It applies only when the car add-on is included in an approved booking.

## 2. Vehicle

2019 Kia Sorento, automatic, diesel, seven seats, kept at the property in Rebero, Kigali. The car is handed over clean, roadworthy, and with a full tank unless noted on the handover checklist.

## 3. Rental period and rate

The rental runs for the pick-up and drop-off dates on the booking, at USD 45 per calendar day. Payment is made on site to the host at collection. Late return without agreement is charged at USD 45 for each additional day started.

## 4. Security deposit and excess

A refundable security deposit of USD 500 is held at collection (cash or card pre-authorisation) and returned after the car is checked back in undamaged. The renter is liable for damage, loss, or theft up to USD 500; the insurance covers amounts above that except where cover is void (see section 8).

## 5. Permitted use and geographic limit

The car may be driven within Rwanda only. It may not cross any border. It may not be used for hire or reward, motorsport, towing, off-road driving beyond graded roads, or to carry more passengers than seatbelts.

## 6. Driver eligibility

Every driver must be named on this agreement, be at least 23 years old, and have held a full licence for at least two years. Licence and passport are presented at collection. An International Driving Permit is required where the licence is not in the Latin alphabet.

## 7. Insurance basis

Third-party liability insurance is in place as required by Rwandan law, together with cover for the vehicle above the USD 500 excess. The renter is responsible for the excess on any claim.

## 8. When cover does not apply

Cover is void, and the renter is fully liable, if the car is driven by an unnamed driver, driven under the influence of alcohol or drugs, driven outside Rwanda, used for a prohibited purpose, or damaged through wilful or reckless acts.

## 9. Fuel and mileage

Mileage is unlimited within Rwanda. Fuel is not included; return the car at the same fuel level shown on the handover checklist or the difference plus a USD 15 refuelling fee is deducted from the deposit.

## 10. Condition on return

Return the car to the property on the drop-off date, reasonably clean, with all keys and documents. A joint check is done at handover and return using the same checklist.

## 11. Damage, loss and fines

The renter pays for damage up to the excess, for any traffic fine or toll incurred during the rental, and for the cost of recovering the car if it is left unroadworthy through misuse.

## 12. Breakdown and accident procedure

For a breakdown, call the number on the key fob card. For any accident: make the scene safe, call the police and obtain a report, photograph the vehicles and location, exchange details, and notify the host within 24 hours. Do not admit liability at the scene.

## 13. Prohibited uses

As section 5, and additionally: no smoking in the car, no transport of animals without prior agreement, no sub-letting.

## 14. Termination

The owner may end the rental immediately for a breach of this agreement, and recover the car, with no refund of unused days.

## 15. Liability

The owner is not liable for indirect or consequential loss (missed flights, lost earnings) arising from a vehicle fault, subject to non-excludable rights under Rwandan law.

## 16. Governing law

This agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Rwanda, and the courts of Kigali have jurisdiction.

## 17. Acceptance

By checking the acceptance box in the booking flow, the renter confirms they have read this agreement, meet the driver requirements, and accept its terms for the vehicle and period stated.
